qt: to the Commission Lynn Boylan (The Left), Pernando Barrena Arza (The Left), Leila Chaibi (The Left), Damien Carême (The Left), Ana Miranda Paz (Verts/ALE), Aodhán Ó Ríordáin (S&D), Kathleen Funchion (The Left), Per Clausen (The Left), Saskia Bricmont (Verts/ALE), Mimmo Lucano (The Left), Martin Günther (The Left), Hanna Gedin (The Left), Jonas Sjöstedt (The Left), Estrella Galán (The Left), Emma Fourreau (The Left), Vicent Marzà Ibáñez (Verts/ALE), Rudi Kennes (The Left), Catarina Martins (The Left), Cecilia Strada (S&D), Marc Botenga (The Left), Sandro Ruotolo (S&D), Annalisa Corrado (S&D), Dario Tamburrano (The Left), Diana Riba i Giner (Verts/ALE), Leoluca Orlando (Verts/ALE), Danilo Della Valle (The Left), Jussi Saramo (The Left), Alex Agius Saliba (S&D), Martin Schirdewan (The Left), Kim Van Sparrentak (Verts/ALE) Subject:

Trade unions and civil society organisations (CSOs) across Europe have called on the Commission to end all existing public contracts with Palantir1. Palantir has been widely reported to have directly supported and enabled Israel’s use of AI-targeting in Gaza2. Furthermore, a July 2026 report by the Centre for International Tax Accountability and Research3 found that Palantir pays little to no corporate tax in the Europe, despite hugely benefiting from public contracts. Palantir has also been found to provide data mining tools to Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) in the United States to track and target migrants4. Given Palantir’s support for the genocide in Gaza, and the fact that it has drained public resources and facilitated attacks on migrants in the United States, it is unacceptable that any EU public money would be directed towards this company. Will the Commission: 1.
Disclose and terminate any contracts currently held with Palantir?
Commit to not granting Palantir any future contracts?
Recommend that Member States do not provide Palantir with any public contracts in the light of its complicity in genocide, targeting of migrants in the US and evasive tax practices?
